relationships.subject: Nav1.8 SLiP
relationships.evidence_quote: Overall, these data provide evidence that the Nav1.8 SLiP selectively reduces Nav1.8 channel conductance in sensory neurons in PKA-activated conditions.

relationships.subject: Ank3
relationships.evidence_quote: These data suggest that Nav1.8 conductance is sensitive to Ank3 expression levels in cAMP-kinase-stimulated conditions.

relationships.subject: Nav1.8 SLiP
relationships.evidence_quote: We confirmed that the Nav1.8 SLiP disrupted Nav1.8 and Ank3 binding through a co-immunoprecipitation assay (Figure S4).

key_findings: Nav1.8/Ank3 interaction sustains Nav1.8 conductance and nociceptor hyperexcitability under PKA-activated conditions, but not at baseline.
A lipidated peptide (SLiP) disrupting Nav1.8-Ank3 binding reduced Nav1.8 current, excitability and calcium flux in vitro and (per abstract) neuropathic pain-like behaviors in mice.
